title: Repair a binary search
prompt: values is sorted from smallest to largest, with no repeats. Return the index of target, or -1 when it is not there. Read as few elements as you can: the last check allows 40 reads in an array of 100,000.
hints: Which position is the target at in the failing check?
When low and high are equal, there is still one element left to look at.
Change the loop condition to low <= high.
checkLabels: The first element can be found.
The last element can be found.
Read no more than 40 of the 100,000 elements.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Stops while one element is still unchecked.
Checks every element from the front, which ignores that the array is sorted.

feedback: Trace low and high by hand on a five-element array for the failing target. Look at the moment when they become equal.
